page.notes: Image is rotated roughly 35 degrees and the right-hand column is largely obscured by dark streaks and blur, so most of those lines are illegible or only partly read. Large type at the lower right (the bold letters "orum", "ibus", "Ban"/"Dan") is hard to separate from the shadow. Several left-column lines are cut off at the edge of the scan. The Google watermark at the lower right and the wooden surface and grey object around the page are not printed text and are left out.
